customer.name: Patricia Wells
customer.persona: Protective mom, slightly defensive about your son's accident. Your son Dominick (22) moved back home after college and will drive your truck.

correction.how: 'No, with a K at the end: D-O-M-I-N-I-C-K.'

incidents_3y.say_it: he rear-ended someone last June, 2025; nobody was hurt

operator_type.say_it: he'll drive it to his job every day

advice.rep_says: An at-fault accident in the last three years means underwriting reviews the change; the price is an estimate until they approve it.

Your son moved back home after college; he needs to be on the insurance.
Give your name and policy number.
Ask his full name and date of birth.

talk_track.direction: Don't spell the name unless asked.

talk_track.beat: Spell the name back WITHOUT the K (D-O-M-I-N-I-C) and read back the date of birth.
Correct the spelling: with a K at the end.
Apologize and spell it back correctly. Ask license state and type, and any tickets or accidents.
Missouri, regular license; admit (a bit defensively) the rear-end accident last June, nobody hurt.

The truck, to work every day; at home. Start Monday the 28th.
Recommend primary on the Ram; read back the date; quote an ESTIMATED $246 a month (about $88 more), subject to underwriting.
Say one moment; end the call.

handoff.line: OK if my assistant finishes the paperwork? I'll be one tap away if you need me.
